adjusts.name: brightness

facts.text: A command is framed as '#' + address + sequence + '?VR' (query) or 'VS' (set) + parameter id + instance + parameter; the parameter is eight hex digits (an IEEE-754 float or an integer)
The frame carries the address, a sequence number modulo 0x10000 and a CRC16 XMODEM checksum over the text, and ends with CR
The three channel instances are red 1, green 2 and blue 3
set_brightness takes a list of powers in percent, one per channel, and sends for each channel a channel-switch command (parameter 7006) and a power command (parameter 7013)
A channel is switched on when its power is greater than 0 and off otherwise
Laser powers are set in percentage using floating numbers and the maximum percentage is 100.5
The device status is read from parameter 104 and the class lists Init, Ready, Run, Error, Bootloader and Pending Reset
The device type is read from parameter 100 and should answer 1171, which means RGB-1171
open() enables digital control by setting parameter 7000 to 1; close() disables it with 7000 set to 0 and closes the port

The device error codes 1 to 9 are Command not available, Device is busy, General communication error, Format error, Parameter not available, Parameter is read-only, Value is out of range, Instance is not available, and Parameter general error
The library controls Fisba ReadyBeam laser light sources and was only tested on Ubuntu 22.04
